dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: It's my first time hearing your footsteps.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I'm blind, so I can't be of any help to you.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Still, my hearing is very good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Oh, hello.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Travelers, merchants, and adventurers frequent Gandharva Ville... But your footsteps are more agile than theirs. You must be a lively and lovable youngster.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: That's a good thing, and very rare to come by in Sumeru right now.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Young traveler, may the Greater Lord watch over you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Goodbye, may the Greater Lord watch over you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has something happened in Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Not at all, it's peaceful as always.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: It's just me, a blind old man, worrying about nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: The use of Akasha has been growing in popularity while fewer Dusk Birds are flying out of Sumeru City...

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: I can only hope that this is a sign of progress.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Greater Lord...

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: The Greater Lord may be gone, but the people of Sumeru will never forget the blessings she bestowed upon us.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Youngster, I'm sure you know that every blade of grass and leaf in this land is a blessing from the Greater Lord.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Human life is too short. Will I be alive to see the Dendro Archon bring Sumeru back to its former glory?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Why, hello, hello!

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Many travelers, merchants, and adventurers frequent Gandharva Ville... But your footsteps are more agile than theirs. You're a lively and lovable youngster — and no mistake!

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: That's a good thing, and very rare to come by in Sumeru nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Now then, young traveler, may Lesser Lord Kusanali watch over you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has something happened in Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Ah, there's a question. Now, I might be a blind old codger, but I've certainly heard things. Lots of things, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: After the Akasha was shut down, even the number of birds singing in the forests have increased...

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: It's at times like these that we need youngsters like you up and about.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Lesser Lord Kusanali.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Lesser Lord Kusanali has started guiding Sumeru once more, and I believe that things can only get better from here.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Youngster, I'm sure you know that every blade of grass and every leaf in this land is a blessing from the Dendro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Life is too short... and yet I hope that I shall live long enough to see her deliver us back to glory.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Keon
dialogues.text: Farewell, and may the Dendro Archon protect you.
